request.text: pgustavo ran an attack-simulation tool on WORKSTATION5 that is spraying passwords at the domain and opening WinRM sessions to other hosts. Disable account pgustavo.

package.rationale: pgustavo's elevated cmd.exe (PID 5776) opened and started PurpleSharp.exe /t T1110.003,T1558.003,T1135,T1021.006 (PID 7520) from Downloads; within two seconds it produced failed logons for seven different accounts (password spraying) and it opens WinRM (5985) connections to WORKSTATION7. Disable pgustavo.
